description.zh:
是否为资源解绑所有标签。取值：

- true：是

- false（默认值）：否

>仅当传入的标签键（TagKey）为空时，该参数生效。
description.en:
Specifies whether to remove all tags from resources. Valid values:

*   true
*   false (default)

>  This parameter takes effect only when you specify an empty tag key.

description.zh:
资源所属的地域ID。
>您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~601478~~)查看当前阿里云账号的可用地域列表。
description.en:
The region ID of the resource.

>  You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~601478~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh:
要解绑标签的资源ID列表，最多可以输入50个资源ID。

输入多个资源ID时，格式为`["ResourceId.1","ResourceId.2",...]`。
description.en:
The IDs of the resources from which you want to remove tags. You can enter up to 50 resource IDs.

Enter multiple resource IDs in the `["ResourceId.1","ResourceId.2",...]` format.

description.zh:
要解绑标签的资源类型。取值：

- key：密钥

- secret：凭据
description.en:
The type of the resource from which you want to remove tags. Valid values:

*   key
*   secret

description.zh:
要解绑的标签的标签键，最多可以输入20个标签键。

输入多个标签键时，格式为`["key.1","key.2",...]`。
>标签键不能以aliyun和acs:开头。
description.en:
The keys of the tags that you want to remove. You can enter up to 20 tag keys.

Enter multiple tag keys in the `["key.1","key.2",...]` format.

>  The tag key cannot start with aliyun or acs:.

descriptions.zh:
- RAM用户或RAM角色调用该OpenAPI需要被授予的权限策略详情，请参见[访问控制](~~2767210~~)。

- 您可以同时为多个密钥或多个凭据解绑多个标签，但不支持解绑以aliyun或acs:开头的标签。

- 如果请求参数中输入多个标签键，其中仅部分标签键与资源有关联，接口会调用成功，并为资源解绑这部分标签键对应的标签。
descriptions.en:
You can remove multiple tags from multiple keys or multiple secrets at a time. You cannot remove tags that start with aliyun or acs:.

If you enter multiple tag keys in the request parameters and only some of the tag keys are associated with resources, the operation can be called and the tags whose keys are associated with resources are removed from the resources.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun kms untag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type key --all false --resource-id key-hzz62f1cb66fa42qo0000 --tag-key disk-encryption --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun kms UntagResources --region cn-hangzhou --All false --ResourceId.1 'key-hzz62f1cb66fa42qo0000' --TagKey.1 'disk-encryption' --ResourceType key --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
